risks.title: Failure to adapt to consumer trends
risks.score_rationale: Ranked first among risks, with alarming language (loss of market share, outdated brands). Impact is direct on demand and margin. The Competition category is critical for a fashion brand. Structural risk, unmitigated.

risks.title: International supply chain difficulties
risks.score_rationale: Central risk in the 10-K, mentioned early and in detail. Language is strong (significant capacity constraints, adverse impact). Dependence on foreign manufacturers is high (majority of products). The Industrial category carries high weight due to direct operational impact.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT system failures
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of risks related to IT systems, eCommerce, and AI. Strong language (severely impact, unauthorized access). Dependence on digital systems is high. The addition of AI increases complexity. High weighting for Cybersecurity in tech.

risks.title: Pandemics and health crises
risks.score_rationale: Significant detail in the text, with multiple impacts (supply chain, sales, costs, cybersecurity). Repeated and specific language. Post-COVID context reinforces risk credibility. Macro category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on major wholesale customers
risks.score_rationale: Well-developed risk, with threats of payment issues, order cancellations, and retail consolidation. Concerned language (adverse effect, cessation of sales). The Credit category is critical for cash flow. Mid-positioning in the text, but high intensity.

risks.title: Risks related to artificial intelligence
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of generative AI and its risks (regulatory, reputational, technical effectiveness). Cautious but concerned language (uncertain regulatory environment, adverse consequences). Technology category growing in importance. New focus compared to prior years.

risks.title: Logistics and distribution issues
risks.score_rationale: Centralized system (small number of locations) presented as vulnerable to natural disasters and outages. Strong language (interrupted, adversely affect). Direct impact on customer delivery. Industrial category heavily weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: The company acknowledges the increasing use of generative artificial intelligence and identifies risks related to uncertain regulatory environments, potential reputational consequences, and technical effectiveness.
evidence: Explicit mention of generative AI risks in the Risk Factors section
Cautious but concerned language regarding technical, legal, and reputational impacts
